review_comments.body:
We should rather throw an exception: https://github.com/epam/ai-dial-sdk/blob/cba84e88883c83ffcd86fbcf30d9ef9d878ec0e5/aidial_sdk/exceptions.py#L126-L141

That's what Azure OpenAI API does when context length is exceeded, so we should do the same.

comments.body:
Updated the mapping to raise an invalid request error with code `context_length_exceeded` and param `messages`. The SDK convenience constructor needs model-limit and token-count values that are unavailable at stop-reason conversion, so this uses `InvalidRequestError` with the same error fields and a generic context-limit message.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
